# Keen AI

> Australian AI workflow automation for allied health clinics — physiotherapy,
> psychology, occupational therapy, speech pathology, and podiatry. Founded by
> Zak Levy. Based in Australia.

## About

Keen AI builds custom AI workflows for Australian allied health clinics. We
handle documentation assist, patient recall automation, and intake flows —
integrating with your existing practice management software (Cliniko, Halaxy,
Nookal, Power Diary) and handing you the keys when we're done.

Our approach: discovery audit, build in two to three weeks, deploy and hand
over. No ongoing subscription, no vendor lock-in. You own everything we build.

- **Website:** https://keenai.com.au
- **Email:** zak@keenai.com.au
- **Location:** Australia
- **Founded by:** Zak Levy
- **Specialties:** Clinical Documentation Automation, Patient Recall Automation, Intake Flow Automation, Healthcare Workflow AI
- **Target clients:** Allied health clinic owners (physio, psychology, OT, speech pathology, podiatry), 2–10 practitioners

## Services

- [Discovery Audit](https://keenai.com.au/#how-it-works): Focused workflow audit mapping your clinic's documentation, recall, intake, and billing processes to identify the highest-value automations.
- [Custom AI Workflow Build](https://keenai.com.au/#how-it-works): Two-to-three week build of custom AI workflows shaped around your PMS, clinical protocols, and practice operations.
- [Deploy & Handover](https://keenai.com.au/#how-it-works): Deployment into your live environment, team training, and full handover with two weeks of post-launch support.

## What We Build

- **Documentation assist** — AI-drafted SOAP notes and progress reports from session audio, reviewed and signed off by the clinician.
- **Recall automation** — Automated patient recall sequences triggered by treatment plans, integrated with your PMS.
- **Intake flow** — End-to-end new patient intake from online forms through to appointment booking and Medicare eligibility checks.
